_doc: Vehicle archetype → business type mapping. Use when framing client types, market segments, or AI use-case categories. Pull the archetype that matches the client's actual business posture, not what they wish they were.

archetypes.characteristics: Light, hot, expensive, breaks often, needs pit crew
archetypes.ai_implication: Massive parallelization, throughput > breadth, redundancy critical
archetypes.punchline: You're not running a race car, you're running a fleet of them and pretending each one is the same driver.

archetypes.business_type: Durable business, weathers downturns, low-maintenance long haul
archetypes.characteristics: Slow but rock-solid, ground clearance, redundant systems
archetypes.ai_implication: Deterministic + fault-tolerant, batched processes, can't be the prettiest
archetypes.punchline: You don't put a Land Cruiser on a quarter-mile strip. You take it where the road ends.

archetypes.business_type: Agile mid-market, controlled chaos, pivots on a dime
archetypes.characteristics: RWD = bias toward action, hand brake = manual override gate, takes skill to drive well
archetypes.ai_implication: Wide capability per agent, requires an operator who can read the slide and counter
archetypes.punchline: A drift car looks chaotic from the outside. The driver knows exactly where the back end is going.

archetypes.business_type: Modern AI-native business, software-defined, instant torque
archetypes.characteristics: Smaller engine, instant torque, regenerative braking, depends on charging network
archetypes.ai_implication: Tight integration, recursive learning capture (regen), dependent on API quotas (charging)
archetypes.punchline: EVs don't need a transmission. AI-native businesses don't need the old gear stack either.

archetypes.characteristics: Cost-per-mile is everything, parts cheap, reliability > performance
archetypes.ai_implication: Smaller models (Haiku), fewer integrations, durability > performance ceiling
archetypes.punchline: A Civic doesn't lose to a Lambo at the office. It wins on the only metric that matters: showing up every day for ten years.

archetypes.business_type: Enterprise with deep pockets, slow decisions
archetypes.characteristics: Comfort layer thick, redundancy, support infrastructure heavy
archetypes.ai_implication: UX layer thick, governance heavy, change cycles measured in quarters
archetypes.punchline: An S-Class doesn't accelerate hard because it's slow. It accelerates hard because the passengers shouldn't notice it accelerating at all.

archetypes.characteristics: Capacity > elegance, work-first, payload over polish
archetypes.ai_implication: Bulk batch processing, throughput-heavy, single-purpose pipelines
archetypes.punchline: Trucks aren't fast. They don't need to be. They move the thing nobody else can move.

archetypes.characteristics: Front-end polish, garage queen risk, doesn't get driven hard
archetypes.ai_implication: Front-end / content / design AI over operations AI. Doesn't actually do much real work.
archetypes.punchline: Show cars win trophies. They don't win races. Most 'AI strategies' are show cars.

archetypes.characteristics: No memory, no hooks, no harness
archetypes.ai_implication: What 95% of businesses are running. Works for nothing serious.
archetypes.punchline: Stock is fine until you ask it to do anything stock wasn't built for.

archetypes.business_type: Light customization (basic memory + a few hooks)
archetypes.punchline: A cold air intake doesn't make a Civic a race car. A few hooks don't make ChatGPT autonomous.

archetypes.characteristics: Engine, harness, ECU, dashboard, telemetry, maintenance schedule
archetypes.punchline: A full build isn't more horsepower. It's every system on the car talking to every other system.

archetypes.business_type: Legacy business retrofitted with modern AI infrastructure
archetypes.characteristics: Classic body, modern drivetrain — analog soul, digital guts
archetypes.ai_implication: Mike's sweet spot for many client engagements
archetypes.punchline: A restomod looks like 1969 and drives like 2025. That's exactly what most businesses need their AI to do.

archetypes.business_type: Stuff you built and never use (the 92% unused skills problem)
archetypes.ai_implication: Workflows / agents / skills built once, used zero times
archetypes.punchline: Every garage queen is somebody's monument to a Saturday they had time and a problem they didn't have.

archetypes.characteristics: Reliable, owned, broken-in, fits the driver
archetypes.ai_implication: The workflow you actually use, that pays for itself in opens
archetypes.punchline: Garage queens get washed. Daily drivers get driven.
